svg.title: January and July 2024 continuous model sections
svg.desc: Eastward total and low-pass model flow at a fixed offshore section, with complete-month velocity and salinity profiles. The older single hourly reading is shown separately. All hourly samples, support counts and statistics are retained in the accompanying section report and numeric asset. Quantiles describe temporal variability, not confidence intervals. No physical current edges, widths, seasonal width range or annual extrema are inferred.
